skymen_jsoneditor.name: JSON Editor
skymen_jsoneditor.description: An in-game tree editor for JSON, Dictionary and Array objects, and for global variables.

group-source.name: Source
group-source.desc: What the editor reads from and writes back to.

source-object.name: Source object
source-object.desc: The JSON, Dictionary or Array object to edit; how to read it is worked out from its type. Leave empty to bind from events instead.

edit-globals.name: Edit global variables
edit-globals.desc: Edit the project's global variables instead of an object. The source object is ignored when this is on.

auto-refresh.name: Auto refresh
auto-refresh.desc: Re-read the source periodically so changes made by events show up in the editor.

refresh-interval.name: Refresh interval (ms)
refresh-interval.desc: How often the source is re-read while Auto refresh is on.

group-editing.name: Editing
group-editing.desc: What the user is allowed to change.

allow-edit-values.name: Edit values
allow-edit-values.desc: Allow editing scalar values. Turn off for a read-only viewer.

allow-object-keys.name: Add/remove object keys
allow-object-keys.desc: Show an add bar and a remove button on the keys of plain objects.

allow-rename-keys.name: Rename keys
allow-rename-keys.desc: Make object key names editable in place.

allow-array-elements.name: Add/remove array elements
allow-array-elements.desc: Show the add bar and remove buttons on arrays.

allow-reorder.name: Reorder array elements
allow-reorder.desc: Show the move up and move down buttons on arrays.

allow-resize-c2array.name: Resize c2arrays
allow-resize-c2array.desc: Allow the width, height and depth of a c2array to be changed.

add-buttons.name: Add buttons
add-buttons.desc: Which kinds of new entry the add bar offers.

group-c2.name: C2 formats
group-c2.desc: Special handling for the c2array and c2dictionary wrappers Construct writes.

detect-c2array.name: Detect c2array
detect-c2array.desc: Show an object holding c2array/data/size as an editable grid.

detect-c2array-string.name: Detect c2array in strings
detect-c2array-string.desc: Also parse string values that hold a serialised c2array, and write them back as strings.

detect-c2dictionary.name: Detect c2dictionary
detect-c2dictionary.desc: Show an object holding c2dictionary/data as a flat list of keys.

detect-c2dictionary-string.name: Detect c2dictionary in strings
detect-c2dictionary-string.desc: Also parse string values that hold a serialised c2dictionary, and write them back as strings.

show-c2array-dims.name: Show c2array size
show-c2array-dims.desc: Show the width x height x depth inputs on a c2array.

show-c2array-zbar.name: Show c2array z plane bar
show-c2array-zbar.desc: Show the z plane selector when a c2array is more than one plane deep.

group-theme.name: Theme
group-theme.desc: How the editor is styled. Layout is fixed; a theme only describes colour.

theme.name: Theme
theme.desc: Which built-in theme to start with.

custom-css.name: Custom CSS
custom-css.desc: A CSS file from the project's Files folder, loaded on startup.

custom-css-mode.name: Custom CSS mode
custom-css-mode.desc: Whether the custom CSS file adds to the built-in theme, so it only has to override what it wants, or replaces it outright.

items.append: Add on top of what is there

group-top-bar.name: Top bar
group-top-bar.desc: Which controls the editor shows, and what closing it does.

ui-scale.name: UI scale
ui-scale.desc: Multiplies the base font size the whole editor is laid out in.

tab-bar.name: Tab bar
tab-bar.desc: When to show the tab bar.

show-filter.name: Show filter box
show-filter.desc: Show the key filter input in the toolbar.

show-collapse-all.name: Show collapse all
show-collapse-all.desc: Show the Collapse all button in the toolbar.

show-close.name: Show close button
show-close.desc: Show a close button in the tab bar.

close-behaviour.name: Close behaviour
close-behaviour.desc: What the close button does after flushing pending edits. On close clicked fires either way.

long-value-chars.name: Long value length
long-value-chars.desc: Values longer than this get a resizable multi-line field instead of a single line one.

commit-debounce.name: Commit debounce (ms)
commit-debounce.desc: How long typing pauses before an edit is written back to the source.

press-freeze.name: Press freeze (ms)
press-freeze.desc: Refreshes are held off for this long while a pointer is held down, so the tree cannot rebuild mid-drag.

block-input.name: Block input
block-input.desc: Stop clicks and key presses inside the editor from reaching the Mouse, Touch and Keyboard objects.

override-cursor.name: Override cursor
override-cursor.desc: Force a normal mouse cursor inside the editor, even if the game hides it.

elem-id.name: ID
elem-id.desc: An optional id for the host element, allowing it to be positioned with CSS. Only used when the element is created.

elem-class.name: Class
elem-class.desc: An optional class for the host element. Only used when the element is created.

style-attribute.name: Style attribute
style-attribute.desc: Initial content of the style attribute for the host element. Only used when the element is created.

add-action-button.display-text: Add action button [b]{0}[/b] labelled [i]{1}[/i] doing [b]{2}[/b] on tab [i]{3}[/i]
add-action-button.description: Add a button to the action bar, or reconfigure one that already exists. A custom button only fires On action button clicked and leaves the rest to you; the built-in kinds work on whichever tab is open, and Save to file writes under the tab's label. Leave the tab empty to show the button on every tab, or name one to move it to its own bar underneath.

button.name: Button ID
button.desc: A name for this button, used by the trigger and by Remove action button.

label.name: Label
label.desc: The text shown on the button. Leave empty to use the default for the kind.

tab.name: Tab
tab.desc: The tab this button belongs to. Leave empty to show it on every tab.

clear-action-buttons.description: Remove every action button, from both bars.

remove-action-button.description: Remove one action button. The bar disappears once it holds none.

set-add-buttons.description: Which kinds of new entry the add bars offer.

set-allow-array-elements.display-text: Set adding and removing array elements [b]{0}[/b]
set-allow-array-elements.description: Whether elements can be added to and removed from arrays.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether elements can be added to and removed from arrays.

set-allow-object-keys.display-text: Set adding and removing object keys [b]{0}[/b]
set-allow-object-keys.description: Whether keys can be added to and removed from plain objects.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether keys can be added to and removed from plain objects.

set-allow-rename-keys.description: Whether object key names can be edited in place.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether object key names can be edited in place.

set-allow-reorder.description: Whether the move up and move down buttons are shown.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the move up and move down buttons are shown.

set-allow-resize-c2array.description: Whether the width, height and depth of a c2array can be changed.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the width, height and depth of a c2array can be changed.

set-detect-c2array.description: Whether an object holding c2array data is shown as a grid.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether an object holding c2array data is shown as a grid.

set-detect-c2array-string.description: Whether string values holding a serialised c2array are parsed and edited as grids.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether string values holding a serialised c2array are parsed and edited as grids.

set-detect-c2dictionary.description: Whether an object holding c2dictionary data is shown as a flat key list.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether an object holding c2dictionary data is shown as a flat key list.

set-detect-c2dictionary-string.description: Whether string values holding a serialised c2dictionary are parsed and edited as key lists.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether string values holding a serialised c2dictionary are parsed and edited as key lists.

set-edit-values.description: Whether scalar values can be edited.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether scalar values can be edited.

set-show-c2array-size.display-text: Set showing the c2array size inputs [b]{0}[/b]
set-show-c2array-size.description: Whether the width x height x depth inputs are shown on a c2array.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the width x height x depth inputs are shown on a c2array.

set-show-c2array-zbar.list-name: Set show c2array z plane bar
set-show-c2array-zbar.display-text: Set showing the c2array z plane bar [b]{0}[/b]
set-show-c2array-zbar.description: Whether the z plane selector is shown on a c2array deeper than one plane.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether the z plane selector is shown on a c2array deeper than one plane.

set-close-behaviour.description: What the close button does after flushing pending edits. On close clicked fires either way.

mode.name: Behaviour
mode.desc: What happens when the close button is clicked.

set-tab-bar.description: When the tab bar should be shown.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: When to show the tab bar.

set-ui-scale.description: Multiply the base font size the whole editor is laid out in. Everything is sized in em, so this scales the tree as a whole.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: The scale factor. 1 is the page's own font size.

show-close-button.description: Whether a close button is shown in the tab bar.

enabled.name: Visible
enabled.desc: Whether a close button is shown in the tab bar.

show-collapse-all.description: Whether the Collapse all button is shown in the toolbar.

enabled.name: Visible
enabled.desc: Whether the Collapse all button is shown in the toolbar.

show-filter.description: Whether the key filter input is shown in the toolbar.

enabled.name: Visible
enabled.desc: Whether the key filter input is shown in the toolbar.

collapse-all.description: Clear the filter and close everything, down to the outer braces.

collapse-path.description: Close one branch, leaving the rest of the tree alone.

path.name: Path
path.desc: A dot separated path, as the JSON plugin writes them, such as "player.inventory.2.name".

expand-all.description: Open every branch of the current tab. Slow on a large document, since the whole tree is built at once.

expand-path.description: Open a branch and everything above it.

path.name: Path
path.desc: A dot separated path, as the JSON plugin writes them, such as "player.inventory.2.name".

scroll-to-path.description: Open a branch and scroll it into view.

path.name: Path
path.desc: A dot separated path, as the JSON plugin writes them, such as "player.inventory.2.name".

set-filter-text.description: Filter the tree to keys matching this text. An empty string clears the filter.

text.name: Text
text.desc: The text to match key names against.

refresh.description: Re-read every tab's source now. Only needed when auto refresh is off.

set-auto-refresh.description: Turn periodic re-reading of the source on or off.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether to re-read the source periodically.

set-refresh-interval.description: How often the source is re-read while auto refresh is on.

set-source-object.description: Point the editor at a JSON, Dictionary or Array object. The first instance is used unless one is picked.

tab.name: Tab
tab.desc: Which tab to change. Leave empty for the current tab.

set-source-to-globals.display-text: Set source of tab [i]{0}[/i] to global variables
set-source-to-globals.description: Point a tab at the project's global variables instead of an object.

tab.name: Tab
tab.desc: Which tab to change. Leave empty for the current tab.

set-source-uid.display-text: Set source of tab [i]{1}[/i] to UID [b]{0}[/b]
set-source-uid.description: Point the editor at one specific instance, by its unique ID.

uid.name: UID
uid.desc: The unique ID of the instance to edit.

tab.name: Tab
tab.desc: Which tab to change. Leave empty for the current tab.

add-globals-tab.display-text: Add tab [b]{0}[/b] labelled [i]{1}[/i] for global variables
add-globals-tab.description: Add a tab showing the project's global variables. Keys cannot be added or removed, and each write is coerced back to the type the variable already holds.

tab.name: Tab ID
tab.desc: A name for this tab, used by the other tab actions.

label.name: Label
label.desc: The text shown on the tab button.

add-tab.description: Add a tab bound to an object, or reconfigure one that already exists. How to read the object is worked out from its type. The tab bar appears once there is more than one tab.

tab.name: Tab ID
tab.desc: A name for this tab, used by the other tab actions.

label.name: Label
label.desc: The text shown on the tab button.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The JSON, Dictionary or Array object this tab edits.

clear-tabs.description: Remove every tab, leaving the editor unbound.

remove-tab.description: Remove a tab and everything the editor remembered about it.

select-tab.description: Switch to a tab, as clicking its button would.

load-css-from-file.description: Load a .css file from the project's Files folder. Adding it on top means the file only has to override the --je-* variables it cares about; replacing means it becomes the theme. The layout layer is applied first either way and is never affected.

filename.name: File
filename.desc: The name of a .css file in the project's Files folder.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Whether the file adds to what is already there or replaces it.

items.append: Add on top of what is there

load-css-string.description: Apply CSS supplied directly, for a theme built or fetched by events. Adding it on top means it only has to override the --je-* variables it cares about; replacing means it becomes the theme. The layout layer is applied first either way and is never affected.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: Whether the CSS adds to what is already there or replaces it.

items.append: Add on top of what is there

set-theme.description: Switch to one of the built-in themes. Any CSS loaded on top of the previous theme is cleared.

on-action-button-clicked.description: Triggered when that action button is pressed. Built-in buttons fire it too, after they have done their work.

on-any-action-button-clicked.description: Triggered when any action button is pressed. Use Action button ID to tell which.

on-any-edit.description: Triggered after any edit at all, in addition to the specific trigger for it.

on-close-clicked.description: Triggered when the close button is clicked, after pending edits have been written.

on-element-added.description: Triggered after an element has been added to an array or a c2array.

on-element-removed.description: Triggered after an element has been removed from an array or a c2array.

on-element-reordered.description: Triggered after an array element has been moved. LastOldValue holds the index it came from.

on-field-blurred.description: Triggered when a value field loses focus. LastPath holds its path.

on-field-focused.description: Triggered when the user puts the caret in a value field. LastPath holds its path.

on-key-added.description: Triggered after a key has been added to an object or a dictionary.

on-key-removed.description: Triggered after a key has been removed from an object or a dictionary.

on-key-renamed.description: Triggered after a key has been renamed. LastOldValue holds the previous name.

on-value-changed.description: Triggered after a value edited in the editor has been written to the source.

on-tab-selected.description: Triggered when the user switches to a different tab.

action-button-id.description: The ID of the action button that was last pressed.

last-key.description: The key or index the last edit touched.

last-old-value.description: What was there before the last edit: the previous value, the previous key name, or the index an element came from.

last-path.description: The dot separated path of the last edit or focus change, such as player.inventory.2.name.

last-value.description: The value the last edit wrote. Empty for removals.

filter-text.description: The filter text last set by an action.

current-tab.description: The ID of the tab currently being shown.

last-tab-id.description: The ID of the tab the last edit or tab change happened on.

theme.description: The name of the current built-in theme, or "custom" when a stylesheet replaced it.
